blocks.text: Veteran Filipino actor Archi Adamos reached a major career milestone at 70 years old. He recently won Best Actor at the US-based Authentic Global Film Awards. During a Thanksgiving Reception at Makati city, “Pater Noster” director Dr. Moutaz Kotrob handed over the trophy. The plaque honors Adamos’s standout performance in the film. This victory follows four decades of work across Philippine theater and cinema.
